Happy to walk through what I can confirm:

**Pricing:** Weekdays (Mon–Thu) are $180/hour with a 4-hour minimum; weekends (Fri–Sun) are $260/hour with a 5-hour minimum. Full-day buyout is $2,400 weekday / $3,600 weekend. There's a $500 security deposit, returned within 7 days after the event.

**What's included:** Setup/teardown (1 hour before and after, free), AV (projector, 2 wireless mics, Sonos system), and free parking in our 30-space lot. In-house catering runs $35–$65/person, or bring your own caterer for a $200 kitchen fee.

**Cancellation policy and discounts:** I don't have those details on hand, so let me get our events manager to confirm that for you — they'll email you today.

**Fall availability:** In October, I show 10/3, 10/10, and 10/17 (Saturday) open, plus most weekdays.
